prompt: Explain to me how a gain and lift chart is calculated and how it should be interpreted
response: A gain and lift chart is a tool used to predict the performance of an aircraft under different conditions. It shows how the aircraft will perform at different speeds and altitudes. The chart shows the maximum lift coefficient and the corresponding speed at which the aircraft can achieve lift. The gain and lift chart is useful for planning takeoff and landing procedures, as it helps in determining the required speed and altitude.
